669: (17) Two: And we are not accustomed to [have the Kohanim] go up to [bless the congregation] because drunkenness is common (Levush). But in the Aliyah Rabbah, [the author] wrote that in Prague, they are accustomed to [have them] go up during the additional prayers (mussaf). And there are some [places where] they go up during the morning service. Every place should follow its custom, but they should be careful not to drink.
